title: The Launch 'Review and publish' screen has no link into it from anywhere, and it runs on a temporary loader instead of the Vera draft builder.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: REVIEW_HREF (lib/launch/review.ts:10) is only used for error redirects in lib/launch/actions.ts:197; rg 'step/review' finds no href/redirect into it. app/(main)/launch/step/review/page.tsx:29 calls loadReviewDraft, whose header lib/launch/review-io.ts:9 says 'TEMPORARY loader: lane E's buildout supplies the real BuildoutDraft'. buildDraftAction (lib/launch/actions.ts:191) has no caller, so buildLaunchDraft (buildout-io.ts:78) never runs.

WHY IT MATTERS: The one-screen 'everything built from what you told us' promise cannot be reached, and when reached it shows only what the person already saved: no AI-built tagline, about, site headline or first email. The Vera-built launch is the headline Jan 1 experience. (LAUNCH_SYSTEM_ENABLED=1 in Vercel production, verified 2026-11-16.)

FIX DIRECTION: Link Spotlight step success to REVIEW_HREF, call buildLaunchDraft from the review page (or a Build button using buildDraftAction), and replace loadReviewDraft with the stored buildout.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
